input.lugar: wide, quiet departure lounge of a generic airport (must not imitate the Jorge Chávez terminal architecture)
input.escena: a traveler stands by the large window with a backpack on his shoulder and a boarding pass in his hand, looking outside; beyond the glass a pearl-grey sky and fine drizzle droplets on the window. It reads as calm waiting before an early flight, not as a delay
input.clima: Lima garúa drizzle, even diffuse light, luminous exposure without inventing sun
input.primerPlano: the backrest of a waiting-area seat
input.prohibir: sun or blue sky, readable boarding pass text, flight display screens or clocks with readable time, aircraft through the window, airline uniforms, aircraft of any kind, airport apron, jet bridges
input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the man stands farther from the camera; his whole figure, head to feet, spans from 18% to 48% of the frame height, centred between 42% and 58% of the width. Beyond the glass there is ONLY the pale grey drizzle sky and a distant blurred skyline: no aircraft, no apron, no jet bridge, no vehicles. The lower half is calm floor, mid-tone. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 28–35 mm equivalent, contextual and immersive.
